scope_note: This is the generation-13 corrective pass resolving all 3 reopen findings from PR #5620: (1) Strategy adapter rapid mutation proof: Removed invalid COMMIT_TIME_UNCHANGED check where entry['updated_at'] == original_entry['updated_at'] caused rapid same-second real-owner mutations to be falsely rejected because models.py:16 truncates timestamps to seconds. (2) Strict authentication and claim validation before owner I/O: Defaulted _adapter_auth_env to 'strict', required explicit configuration (secret, issuer, audience), removed synthetic :operator compatibility on bare tokens, passed required_roles=_STRATEGY_WRITE_ROLES to validate_request_auth, strictly verified non-empty sub/tenant/roles/exp claims, and performed caller authentication BEFORE any owner I/O. Added real PostgreSQL integration tests for parent linkage and concurrent writers on typed and generic keyed routes.
